bull_case: If VAS and Visa Direct maintain high returns, capital allocation remains highly productive.
bear_case: Repurchases above intrinsic value or large value-destructive acquisitions would weaken this score.
thesis: Management execution is strong, but current buybacks are closer to fair value than obviously cheap. Capital allocation remains rational because excess cash is returned while adjacent growth investments continue.

evidence.claim: 9M FY2026 repurchase average was $328.29 versus locked Base $328.59.
FY2025 10-K had no financial statement correction/restatement flag.

counterevidence: Regulatory and interchange litigation can pressure network economics and pricing over time.
The current valuation already embeds a high-quality compounder profile.
unknowns: Long-run regulation of interchange and routing
Sustainable growth rate of Visa Direct and value-added services
falsifiers: If processed transactions and payments volume decelerate materially while client incentives rise faster than gross revenue, the moat/FCF thesis weakens.
